remarks: Welcome to Woodside Green - Centrally located pet friendly complex attractive for its proximity to Stamford's Metro North, Downtown shops and restaurants, Ridgeway Shopping Plaza, Scalzi Park and Health Clubs...with an easy access to I-95 and Merritt Pkwy, this unit is ideal for commuters. Investors are welcome! Schedule your tour today and see what makes this unit so special!
